coverage: Thirteen inline tests using canonical lexer-created tokens for all public conversions.
Quoted positive, negative, zero, negative-zero, boundary, and overflowing integers.
Canonical error code, Lexer source, absolute token-start offset, default schema and field IDs, and nonempty detail.
Eight-digit SWAR lane ordering, all ten digits in every lane with both zero and nine backgrounds, and maximum chunk value.
Every digit length from 1 through 24 compared to an independent u128 scalar accumulator.
2048 deterministic fixed-seed full-width unsigned and signed values formatted with core and lexed before conversion.
Exact EOF and every legal delimiter at 16 start offsets for lengths 7, 8, 9, 15, 16, 17, 19, and 20.
8192-byte positive, negative, and quoted magnitudes reject without truncation or floating-point fallback.
Input, token metadata, spans, and borrowed spelling remain unchanged on success and failure.
